investigation_record.reasoning_summary: The transaction triggered a moderate ML risk score of 0.61, which is below the high-confidence thresholds seen in historical fraud cases. The graph neighborhood shows no multi-hop linked cards and only one shared device, failing to meet the criteria for Typology B (Distributed Device Ring) which requires at least 3 distinct accounts. Historical precedents indicate that similar or higher risk scores were cleared as benign when cardholders confirmed travel, and no geo-velocity anomalies (Typology E) are present in the current data.
